re_line: Kim possible China visit imminent · DPRK-Russia economic cooperation meeting · GS AI data center groundbreaking · BOK rate hike household pressure
morning_memo: South Korea's National Intelligence Service says it is monitoring signs of an imminent Kim Jong Un visit to China.
North Korea and Russia held their 13th Intergovernmental Economic Cooperation Committee meeting in Pyongyang, agreeing to boost joint projects.
President Lee Jae-myung attended the groundbreaking of GS Group's 2.4 GW AI data center campus in Donghae, Gangwon Province.

key_stat.label: Bank of Korea's revised 2027 GDP growth forecast
key_stat.context: The Bank of Korea raised its 2027 growth projection by 1.2 percentage points to 4.1% on Nov. 26, the largest single upward revision since December 2008 and Korea's first forecast in the 4% range since 4.7% in 2021.

bp_locations.name: Yongbyon Nuclear Complex
bp_locations.note: As of April 2026: Enrichment building expansion complete, new centrifuge hall operational. 5 MWe reactor and IRT-2000 both running. Thermal signatures consistent with increased plutonium/HEU production.

bp_locations.name: Sinpo South Shipyard
bp_locations.note: As of May 2025: Hero Kim Kun Ok SLBM submarine exited drydock after more than two years of fitting-out but was still not operational. New submarine construction begun in separate bay. NK Pro satellite analysis (Oct 20 2026) separately reports North Korea's Nampho Shipyard missed a deadline earlier in Oct 2026 to launch a 5,000-ton naval destroyer, with hull sections visible at two potential outdoor assembly areas. 38 North analysis published Oct 30 documents public display of a vessel described as a 'Tactical Nuclear Attack' submarine. Kim Jong Un inspected Nampho Shipyard on Nov 7 (reported Nov 8 by KCNA), announcing a new warship under construction larger than the destroyer built last year. NK News reported on Nov 6 that North Korea has expanded warship construction to a third shipyard. 38 North published analysis on Nov 11 of the Choe Hyon destroyer and its strategic implications for the West Sea Fleet. NK News identified a second major east-coast naval base project on Nov 13, beyond the Munchon-area site Kim inspected on Nov 12. Daily NK satellite imagery analyzed Nov 24 places the Kang Kon at Mayang Island naval base and the Choe Hyon at Nampo, with shipyard expansion visible at Chongjin and Nampo consistent with additional large-warship construction.

bp_locations.name: THAAD Site, Seongju County
bp_locations.note: As of March 2026: All 6 THAAD launchers were redeployed to the Middle East amid Iran tensions. At least 2 launchers may have returned to Seongju by late March 2026. Battery operational status remains uncertain. This report is from March 2026 and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Sohae Satellite Launch Station
bp_locations.note: As of March 2026: 2,500 kN engine test stand firing observed. Two villages razed for facility expansion. New seaport and large assembly building nearing completion. This report is from March 2026 and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Punggye-ri Nuclear Test Site
bp_locations.note: As of November 2025: ROK Defense Intelligence Agency assessed Tunnel No. 3 is test-ready and a nuclear test can be conducted at any time upon political decision. Site maintained at high readiness since mid-2024. This report is from November 2025 and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Tumangang–Khasan (NK-Russia border)
bp_locations.note: As of March 2026: Road bridge construction accelerated, completion target moved to Summer 2026. Passenger rail service resumed mid-2025. Ore and tank car traffic at highest levels since project began. Russian Transport Ministry applications filed November 13, 2026 for a 14-daily-round-trip Vladivostok-Rason bus route over the new vehicle bridge, with experts noting the service will likely transport DPRK workers more than Russian tourists.

bp_locations.name: Sinuiju–Dandong (NK-China border)
bp_locations.note: NK News Planet Labs satellite imagery analyzed through November 15, 2026 confirms trucks filling Sinuiju customs facility from October 16, the day after the New Yalu River Bridge officially opened, with activity peaking October 19–20. A wall of 40-foot containers bearing Maersk and COSCO markings was visible on the Chinese side. Kim Jong Un crossed the New Yalu River Bridge on October 24 during his unannounced visit to Dandong. Daily NK reported November 18 that Sinuiju markets are overflowing with Chinese goods but a severe cash shortage means almost nobody is buying, with vendors describing a 'trading cliff.' Daily NK reported November 23 that low-income families in Sinuiju are sinking into crisis as market prices for food and daily necessities soar despite state promotion of Sinuiju development as a model for regional growth. NK News reported November 26 that Dandong has announced plans to simplify customs procedures for small-scale border trade and make greater use of the New Yalu River Bridge over the next five years, with border residents within 20 kilometers eligible to register for passes allowing duty-free imports of up to 8,000 yuan per day.

bp_locations.name: Rason SEZ
bp_locations.note: As of November 2025: Chinese businesspeople re-entry to Rason SEZ expanded. Coal exports through Rason at highest levels in years throughout 2025. Arms export berth also active. This report is from November 2025 and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Yellow Sea NLL
bp_locations.note: Herald Economy reported November 23 that a North Korean vessel marked 'Marine Police' was spotted near Yeonpyeong Island, with the ROK Joint Chiefs confirming they are tracking and monitoring the vessel. As of September 26, 2025: 140m DPRK merchant vessel Toksong crossed the Northern Limit Line near Baengnyeong Island, advanced 5km south. ROK Marine Corps Commandant Gen. Ju Il-suk stated October 20, 2026 that North Korea has made 'various changes' to forces facing South Korea's border islands.

bp_locations.name: Yellow Sea PMZ
bp_locations.note: As of January 27-28, 2026: Atlantic Amsterdam (converted oil rig, Chinese aquaculture platform) relocated out of the Provisional Measures Zone to Weihai shipyard following President Lee Jae-myung's Beijing state visit. Two giant aquaculture cages (Shen Lan 1, Shen Lan 2) and 13 buoys remain in the PMZ. This report is from January 2026 and may not reflect the current state.

bp_locations.name: Vostochny/Dunai
bp_locations.note: As of January 2026: Arms shipments slowed due to ice, one Russian vessel (likely Angara or Lady R) visited Rason, docked January 14, 2026 at arms export berth. Cargo routed to Vostochny. Since September 2023: 64 voyages by 4 vessels (Angara, Maria, Maya-1, Lady R) delivered approximately 15,800 containers (approximately 4.2-5.8 million munitions) from Rajin to Vostochny/Dunai. Russian Transport Ministry applications filed November 13, 2026 for a Vladivostok-Rason bus route operating 14 daily round trips. NK News reported November 24 that the Ukrainian military struck the cargo freighter Angara, one of the four vessels in the documented arms-transfer fleet, in a drone attack that also sank the Russian corvette Merkury.

top_stories.headline: NIS monitors signs of imminent Kim Jong Un visit to China
top_stories.body: South Korea's National Intelligence Service said Saturday it is 'monitoring various developments' amid speculation that **Kim Jong Un** could make another visit to China. Speculation centers on Chinese President Xi Jinping's briefing to President Lee Jae-myung about North Korea-China relations at their APEC Shenzhen summit last week; the presidential office said there was 'no mention to the effect reported by the media' but confirmed it is closely monitoring North Korea-China relations. Kim made an unannounced one-day visit to Dandong on October 24, where he met Wang Huning, China's top political adviser.

top_stories.headline: North Korea and Russia hold 13th economic cooperation committee meeting, agree to boost joint projects
top_stories.body: North Korea and Russia convened the 13th Meeting of their Intergovernmental Committee for Cooperation in Trade, Economy, Science and Technology in Pyongyang, agreeing to activate bilateral cooperation projects. KCNA reported the meeting under the headline 'Respected Comrade Kim Jong Un Sends Congratulatory Message to President of Mauritania' in the same news cycle, with the economic committee meeting listed separately. The meeting follows Russia's Nov. 24 agreement to pay North Korea in fuel after a currency dispute, the latest in a series of bilateral economic transactions tracked since late 2022.

top_stories.headline: Lee breaks ground on GS Group's 2.4 GW AI data center campus in Gangwon, calling AI race a 'silent war'
top_stories.body: **President Lee Jae-myung** attended the groundbreaking of GS Group's AI data center campus in Donghae, Gangwon Province, the first of the government's three major megaprojects to begin construction. GS Group Chairman **Huh Tae-soo** attended alongside Science and ICT Minister **Bae Kyung-hoon**; the facility is projected at up to *120 trillion won* ($89.79 billion) in total value including GPU costs, with an initial 1.2 GW phase targeting completion and operation in 2029. Lee described the global AI technology race as 'a silent war at the national level' and pledged to 'mobilize all capabilities' to make South Korea a standard-setting country.

also_today.headline: Pukchang Air Base resumes operations with MiG-23s after three-year renovation
also_today.body_text: NK News Planet Labs and Maxar imagery shows MiG-23 fighters operating at Pukchang Air Base after a three-year renovation that extended the runway to 2,800 m and added 16 canopy shelters; North Korea marks Aviation Day on November 29.

also_today.headline: Daily NK: North Korea's IV Corps overhauled from coastal defense to offensive posture since 2024
also_today.body_text: Daily NK satellite imagery and sourcing report North Korea's IV Corps has 'completely overhauled' its mission from coastal defense of the five islands to a broader offensive orientation, incorporating drones and new weapons systems.

also_today.headline: NIS director nominee Kang Kum-sil rejects 'pro-China' allegations, says advisory roles were honorary under Park government
also_today.body_text: National Intelligence Service director nominee **Kang Kum-sil** stated Saturday that her two Chinese local-government special adviser appointments, in 2013 and 2014, were unpaid honorary positions during the Park Geun-hye administration's period of warm South Korea-China relations, dismissing opposition allegations of pro-China bias.

also_today.headline: Korea Coast Guard imposes up to 1.5 billion won security deposits on 13 Chinese fishing vessels
also_today.body_text: The Korea Coast Guard has imposed 12.7 billion won in security deposits on 13 Chinese fishing vessels caught illegally fishing since the amended EEZ law took effect May 12, 2026; none of the vessels apprehended for unauthorized fishing this year have been able to pay the substantially higher amounts.

overnight_items.headline: North Korean rice prices fall nearly 10% after harvest but remain elevated
overnight_items.body_text: Drop smaller than last year's post-harvest slide.

overnight_items.headline: Sinuiju traders clash with market officials over stall-downsizing rights
overnight_items.body_text: Falling sales driving downsizing; market office refuses private sub-lease.

overnight_items.headline: North Hamgyong authorities crack down on elderly street vendors in Orang
overnight_items.body_text: Crackdown follows complaints to county party committee.

overnight_items.headline: MND establishes Korean Armed Forces Academy founding task force, launching Dec. 2
overnight_items.body_text: Twenty-person tri-service unit to unify officer education from 2027.

overnight_items.headline: PPP leader Jang Dong-hyuk vows to 'march on the Blue House' to press for resumption of Lee's trial
overnight_items.body_text: Calls Lee a president 'in hiding'; demands immediate trial restart.

overnight_items.headline: US and China clash at IAEA over South Korea's nuclear-powered submarine negotiations
overnight_items.body_text: Washington backs IAEA authority to negotiate ROK submarine safeguards; Beijing objects.

us_korea_deals.state_of_play: Steel and aluminum remain at 50% and automobiles at 15%, both under Section 232. The Section 122 surcharge expired July 24, so there is no baseline reciprocal tariff currently in force. The Section 301 investigation launched March 11, 2026 is now the primary prospective tariff vehicle.

trade_policy.item: BIS Semiconductor Export Controls, Samsung and SK Hynix China fabs
trade_policy.detail: Samsung and SK Hynix China fabs operating under annual BIS export licenses renewed December 30, 2025 for 2026; maintenance and incremental upgrades only, no capacity expansion; shifted from indefinite VEU waivers to restrictive annual licenses in January 2026.

trade_policy.item: IRA Battery Sourcing Rules (FEOC), Korean EV battery makers
trade_policy.detail: Foreign Entity of Concern rules affect LG Energy Solution, SK On, Samsung SDI sourcing from China; battery components phase-in December 2024, critical minerals December 2025.

trade_policy.detail: Samsung received preliminary $6.4B CHIPS Act award (April 2024) for Taylor TX fabs; 10-year restriction on materially expanding semiconductor manufacturing in countries of concern; Samsung Xi'an NAND fab limited to legacy production.

business_economy.headline: Bank of Korea raises 2027 growth forecast to 4.1%, highest single-year revision since 2008
business_economy.body_text: The Bank of Korea raised its 2027 GDP growth forecast from 2.9% to 4.1% on Nov. 26, a 1.2 percentage-point upward revision described as the largest since December 2008; the 2026 forecast was also raised from 3.3% to 3.9%. The IMF separately raised its 2027 Korea forecast to 3.3% and the Korea Development Institute to 3.9% earlier this month.

business_economy.headline: BOK's three rate hikes push average mortgage past 5%, with some overdrafts above 7%
business_economy.body_text: Average fixed-rate mortgage rates reached 5.13% in October 2026, rising for 13 consecutive months; a borrower with a 500 million won mortgage at 4.25% would pay 312,500 won more per month if rates rise a further 0.75 percentage point to 5%. Some forecasts project mortgage rates reaching 8% in 2027.

business_economy.headline: GS Group breaks ground on 1.2 GW Donghae AI data center, first groundbreaking of government megaproject list
business_economy.body_text: GS Group began construction at the North Pyeong industrial complex in Donghae, Gangwon Province, investing 30 trillion won total across two 1.2 GW phases; the first 100 MW portion targets completion in Q2 2028. GS Group Chairman Huh Tae-soo said the facility aims to make South Korea a 'global hub of the AI era.'

business_economy.headline: Nvidia and Kioxia team on AI server memory as alternative to South Korean chips
business_economy.body_text: Nvidia is working with Kioxia on AI server memory solutions that could serve as an alternative to South Korean memory chips from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

business_economy.headline: POSCO workers accept 2.6% base pay rise, one-off 6.2 million won payment
business_economy.body_text: POSCO's union accepted a 2.6% base pay increase and 6.2 million won lump-sum after five months of negotiations, down from an initial demand for 7.1% and 600% performance bonus.

business_economy.headline: Rainbow Robotics jumps 30% in a week on continued 'Samsung effect'
business_economy.body_text: Shares of Rainbow Robotics rose 30% in a single week as investor sentiment around Samsung's robotics investments continued to lift the sector.

northeast_asia.headline: US backs IAEA authority to negotiate ROK submarine safeguards; China objects
northeast_asia.body_text: The United States backed the International Atomic Energy Agency's authority to negotiate nuclear safeguards for South Korea's planned nuclear-powered submarine program after China raised objections at the IAEA. The dispute reflects Beijing's resistance to South Korea's naval nuclear ambitions and their implications for regional deterrence.

gallup_spotlight.finding: 7 in 10 stock investors in South Korea lost money in 2026, according to a Gallup Korea poll.

rok_government.action: Defense Minister inspects Army reserve division drone demonstration unit
rok_government.detail: Defense Minister Kang Shin-cheol visited the Army 72nd Infantry Division (reserve) on November 27 to inspect drone demonstration units equipped with advanced science and technology systems, encouraging transition of reserve forces toward unmanned combat systems.

rok_assembly.action: DP Minister Park Hong-geun and committee chair Seo Young-gyo clash over committee authority and district budget questions
rok_assembly.detail: Planning and Budget Minister Park Hong-geun and National Assembly Judiciary Committee Chair Seo Young-gyo publicly clashed over the committee's authority, with Park accusing the committee of acting like a 'senate upper chamber,' and both sides continuing the dispute on social media after the hearing.

calendar_watch.headline: DPRK Aviation Day
calendar_watch.detail: North Korea marks Aviation Day on November 29; Kim Jong Un has used the occasion in recent years for air force events, and Pukchang Air Base resumed operations this week.

rok_personnel.name: Kang Kum-sil
rok_personnel.detail: Kang Kum-sil is the nominee for NIS director, facing opposition allegations of pro-China bias due to honorary advisory roles in Chinese provincial governments in 2013 and 2014; she responded Saturday that those were unpaid ceremonial positions during the Park Geun-hye government era.

official_x_posts.quote_text: GS Group's bold investment decision to build Asia's largest AI infrastructure in a region outside the capital, with the swift and proactive support of Gangwon Province and Donghae City, allowed the project to proceed at speed. Gangwon, which laid the foundation of Korea's industrialization through coal and cement, is now rising as a new hub of the AI industry.
official_x_posts.analyst_note: Lee's post accompanied his physical attendance at the GS Donghae AI data center groundbreaking, the first construction start among the government's three declared megaprojects announced in June.

official_x_posts.quote_text: We broke ground on the Donghae AI Data Center today. Donghae's advantage is that power generated nearby can be used close to source. Using electricity produced on the east coast for AI computing nearby reduces long-distance transmission burdens and creates opportunities for new industries and jobs in the region.
official_x_posts.analyst_note: The Science and ICT Minister's post accompanied President Lee's groundbreaking attendance, noting the facility's proximity to east coast power generation as a structural advantage for data-center economics.

opeds_today.headline: Political Dynamics of the Takaichi Administration and the Outlook for ROK-Japan Relations
opeds_today.central_argument: The political constraints and priorities of Japan PM Takaichi Sanae's administration will shape the near-term trajectory of ROK-Japan bilateral relations in ways Seoul must anticipate.
opeds_today.summary: Sejong Institute Brief 2026-32 examines the domestic political dynamics of the Takaichi Sanae administration and their implications for South Korea-Japan relations. The brief likely addresses how LDP factional pressures and historical-issue politics affect the bilateral agenda. It is a timely institutional analysis given ongoing ROK-Japan bilateral momentum.

opeds_today.headline: CSIS-DAPA 2026: Transforming the U.S.-ROK Defense Industrial Partnership for the Future
opeds_today.central_argument: The US-ROK defense industrial partnership requires structural transformation to meet evolving security requirements and capitalize on each ally's industrial strengths.
opeds_today.summary: This CSIS report from the CSIS-DAPA 2026 conference covers the future direction of the US-ROK defense industrial partnership. It addresses how both countries can better integrate their defense industries amid modernization demands. The report is directly relevant to ongoing US-ROK alliance cooperation and the MASGA shipbuilding framework.

top_articles.headline: Kim Jong Un attends Russian art troupe's performance in Pyongyang
top_articles.summary: Kim Jong Un attended a performance by a Russian art troupe in Pyongyang, with KCNA framing the event as a reaffirmation of DPRK-Russia friendship.

top_articles.headline: Kim Jong Un urges grassroots party leaders to faithfully relay directives
top_articles.summary: Kim Jong Un met participants of a Workers' Party of Korea cell leaders' conference and urged grassroots party officials to faithfully transmit central directives, reinforcing ideological control.

key_quotes.speaker: Kim Jong Un
key_quotes.quote: The nuclear forces of the DPRK have been built up as a powerful treasured sword to protect the sovereignty and dignity of the state and people, and their status will never change.
key_quotes.context: KCNA report, Nov. 26-27, on nuclear facility inspection and tactical nuclear deployment order
key_quotes.source_article: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture

kcna_delta.bottom_line: KCNA led today with the DPRK-Russia intergovernmental economic cooperation meeting and Kim's attendance at a Russian art troupe performance, while state media maintained complete silence on speculation about Kim's possible China visit.

capitol_hill.headline: White House and Congress pressure South Korea on digital rules; a 'diplomatic factor' in KFTC big-tech sanctions
capitol_hill.body_text: The US White House and Congress are pressing Seoul over digital market regulations, with US pressure described as a 'diplomatic factor' in the Korea Fair Trade Commission's enforcement actions against major technology companies.

korea_world.headline: Iran warns South Korea against expanded Gulf military presence
korea_world.body_text: Iran warned South Korea against expanding its naval role in the Gulf as Seoul readies a larger military presence in the region, according to Reuters. South Korea has been increasing its Middle East defense engagements as part of a broader overseas defense industry push.

korea_world.headline: South Korea secures final victory in $574M Iran investment dispute
korea_world.body_text: South Korea secured a final legal victory in a $574 million investment dispute with Iran, according to UPI.

korea_world.headline: KHNP steps up efforts to advance Czech nuclear power project
korea_world.body_text: Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power is intensifying efforts to advance its nuclear power plant project in the Czech Republic, according to The Korea News Plus.
